title: ZTIE authenticated decision token (v1)
description: The bounded, canonical, allow-listed payload the HUB SIGNS and a SPOKE VERIFIES OFFLINE (RD-048 / RD-049) to authorize exactly one enforcement action for exactly one artifact. It is a Hub -> spoke authenticated instruction (the Hub hands it out; the spoke verifies it against the Hub's embedded public key WITHOUT calling the Hub), NOT a Forensic -> Hub RD-013 crossing. It carries a HUMAN decision (accepted / rejected) for one intake_id, bound to the exact artifact bytes via sha256 and time-stamped via issued_at (freshness/replay bound), plus the key_id of the Hub signing key that produced it. The spoke acts ONLY if the detached signature verifies over the CANONICAL token bytes against a trusted public key AND the decision is the exact value the action requires AND the sha256 matches the recomputed artifact sha256 AND issued_at is fresh AND key_id is trusted; any failure => refuse (fail-closed). It is NOT a verdict: there is NO verdict/safe/approved/forward/pass_fail/malicious/clean field, the advisory recommended_verdict (RD-040) never produces a token, and INCONCLUSIVE issues NO token (a hold). Allow-list: additionalProperties false; every field typed + enum/length/pattern-bounded. The SIGNED bytes are the canonical serialization json.dumps(token, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')). OWN version pin (DECISION_TOKEN_CONTRACT_VERSION).

contract_version.description: Decision-token schema version. Pinned SEPARATELY (DECISION_TOKEN_CONTRACT_VERSION) so this evolves independently of every other ZTIE contract. A spoke rejects an unknown version fail-closed.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this decision authorizes an action for. The spoke acts on exactly this intake.

decision.description: The HUMAN decision. 'accepted' authorizes the Story 4.6 push; 'rejected' authorizes the Story 4.7 destroy. INCONCLUSIVE is NOT a value here — a hold issues no token. NOT a machine verdict.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body this decision is about. BINDS the decision to exact bytes: the spoke acts only if this equals the recomputed sha256 of the artifact it holds, so a token for artifact A cannot authorize an action on artifact B (SI-7).

issued_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the Hub signed this token. The spoke rejects a token whose issued_at is outside a bounded freshness window (a replay bound).

key_id.description: Identifier/fingerprint of the Hub KMS asymmetric signing key that produced the signature. The spoke confirms it verified against a TRUSTED key_id (supports key rotation: a spoke may trust a set of key_ids during a rotation window).
